diagnostics.message: The Karpenter Provisioner manifest sets providerRef.name to "default", matching the AWSNodeTemplate created by node_template, but there is no dependency edge between them. Terraform may apply the Provisioner before its referenced template exists; order the template manifest first.

The Provisioner manifest's providerRef names the AWSNodeTemplate manifest "default", but Terraform can apply the Provisioner first because both only depend on the add-ons module. Make the Provisioner wait for the referenced template so Karpenter does not encounter a temporarily unresolved provider reference.

The direct dependency on the AWS provider manifest is redundant: this provider-config manifest also depends on the 60-second wait resource, which itself depends on the AWS provider manifest, so that ordering is already guaranteed transitively.
The direct dependency on the Helm provider manifest is redundant: helm_provider_config depends on the wait resource, and that wait resource already depends on the Helm provider manifest.
The direct dependency on the Kubernetes provider manifest is redundant: kubernetes_provider_config also depends on the wait resource, which depends on that provider manifest.
